positions.title: Senior Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer, Android Messenger Team
positions.description: Worked on various features to surface 3rd party apps, pictures and video capture, stickers in Android Messenger app.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Android Video Frameworks Team
positions.description: Adapting AOSP video framework to Qualcomm chipset features, worked on kernel module for camera local tone mapping (HDR).
